name: rem2
description: Unofficial — NOT an official Yonsei University or REM2 lab plugin. Built by a grad student who couldn't bear his juniors' daring figures and wanted to ease the pain, if only a little. Consistent scientific/engineering plot styling for MATLAB (axes, legends, labels, time-series, X–Y, 3-D, frequency-response), and a measured-FRF control design workflow — s-domain plant fit with time delay (tfest), automatic lag / lead-lag loop shaping, margin and step-response prediction (MATLAB only, no Simulink). Also ships Git conventions ported from github/awesome-copilot (MIT): Conventional Commits commit workflow and message template, narrative commit messages, lean source-code comments, and SemVer + Keep a Changelog GitHub releases. Plus a thorough README generator ported from sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills (MIT, original by Shpigford).
